data.gender_notes: Gib is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Gib is recorded in name-lists as “Powerful servant”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gib expresses “Powerful servant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gib total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: גִב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: derived from the Hebrew root גבב (gavav), which means 'to be heavy' or 'to be strong'. The name Gib may be derived from the Hebrew word for 'hill' or 'mound', as many places and people in the Bible are named after geographical features.

in_greek.name: Γιβ
in_greek.long_meaning: There is no direct Greek equivalent for the name Gib, as the name is primarily attested in the Hebrew Bible.

in_latin.name: Gib
in_latin.long_meaning: There is no direct Latin equivalent for the name Gib, as it is primarily attested in the Hebrew Bible and is not used in the Latin Vulgate.
